model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the performance trends of four different model variants—Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—across a sequence of x-axis values labeled γ₀ through γ₈. The x-axis, labeled with these γ values, spans from γ₀ to γ₈ with evenly spaced tick marks, and the y-axis, which represents performance, ranges from 4 to 8 with tick marks at integer intervals. The blue line with circular markers represents Llama-3B, starting at a y-value of 4.0 at γ₀ and rising to approximately 8.2 at γ₈. The green line with triangular markers for Llama-3B + FT begins at a y-value of approximately 3.8 at γ₀ and increases to about 8.2 at γ₈. The light blue line with diamond markers for Llama-1B starts at approximately 3.0 at γ₀ and rises to about 8.0 at γ₈. The light green line with inverted triangular markers for Llama-1B + FT begins at approximately 3.0 at γ₀ and increases to about 8.0 at γ₈. All four lines show a general upward trend across the γ values, with the Llama-3B variant consistently achieving the highest performance values throughout the range.
